2608.27424.title: Beyond F1: Evaluating Coverage and Failure Recovery in AI Model Security Scanners
2608.27424.paper_summary: Static scanners are increasingly used to identify executable or otherwise unsafe content in machine- learning artifacts, yet conventional evaluation metrics characterize only cases where a scanner yields a usable security judgment. We evaluate ModelScan, ModelAudit, and Fickling using a controlled, artifact-backed benchmark on a synthetic corpus of 170 Pickle and PyTorch focused artifacts across 145 specimen families, 135 of which have binary security ground truth and 10 of which are intentionally malformed without labels. We explicitly distinguish non-N/A coverage, analysis completion, definitive security decisions, non-security findings, and unsupported outcomes. On labeled families, ModelAudit produced definitive security decisions for all 135 families (100%), Fickling for 110 (81.5%), and ModelScan for 67 (49.6%). Conditional on making a definitive judgment, ModelScan achieved 100% precision, recall, and F1. Fickling identified no unique true- positive families beyond those found by the combination of ModelAudit and ModelScan. Furthermore, for the 48 malicious families where ModelScan failed to complete its analysis, both ModelAudit and Fickling generated detections consistent with ground truth. These findings underscore the need to separate judgment accuracy from judgment availability, as well as incremental detection coverage from tool-level redundancy.
2608.27424.paper_summary_zh: 靜態掃描器越來越多地用於識別機器學習工件中的可執行或其他不安全內容，然而傳統評估指標僅描述掃描器產生可用安全判斷的情況。<lb/>我們使用一個受控的、基於工件的基準，在一個合成語料庫中評估 ModelScan、ModelAudit 和 Fickling，該語料庫包含 170 個以 Pickle 和 PyTorch 為重點的工件，涵蓋 145 個樣本家族，其中 135 個擁有二進制安全真相，10 個則故意損壞且沒有標籤。<lb/>我們明確區分非 N/A 覆蓋範圍、分析完成度、明確的安全決策、非安全發現和不支持的結果。<lb/>在標記的家族中，ModelAudit 為所有 135 個家族產生了明確的安全決策（100%），Fickling 為 110 個（81.5%），而 ModelScan 為 67 個（49.6%）。<lb/>在做出明確判斷的條件下，ModelScan 達到了 100% 的精確度、召回率和 F1 分數。<lb/>Fickling 除了 ModelAudit 和 ModelScan 的組合發現的家族外，未能識別任何獨特的真陽性家族。<lb/>此外，對於 ModelScan 未能完成分析的 48 個惡意家族，ModelAudit 和 Fickling 都生成了與真相一致的檢測結果。<lb/>這些發現強調了將判斷準確性與判斷可用性分開的必要性，以及將增量檢測覆蓋與工具層冗餘分開的必要性。
